name: authorized_is_refused
note: An entry without commit intent may be refused at any time; a late prepared hook is refused commit intent and aborts.

name: authorized_is_refused_even_when_nothing_can_be_read
note: Refusing an authorized entry needs no evidence.

name: committing_receive_still_running_waits
note: The worker enforces the deadline by terminating the receive; until then wait, even if the journal looks decisive.

name: committing_liveness_unavailable_waits
note: Neither liveness nor a stopped worker is established.

name: own_committed_is_applied
note: The transaction's own committed entry is positive evidence.

name: own_committed_when_worker_verified_stopped
note: A worker instance verified stopped is as good as an ended receive.

name: own_aborted_is_refused
note: The transaction's own aborted entry proves it changed nothing.

name: own_committed_beats_a_later_conflicting_value
note: A committed entry settles its own transaction whatever the ref holds now.

name: prepared_only_next_prepared_observed_new_is_applied
note: The next prepared entry for the ref observed the new value: this transaction committed.

name: prepared_only_next_prepared_observed_old_is_refused
note: The next prepared entry for the ref observed the old value: this transaction did not commit.

name: prepared_only_next_prepared_observed_other_is_unknown
note: Neither the old nor the new value.

name: prepared_only_next_prepared_wins_over_current_value
note: The next prepared entry decides even when the current value says otherwise.

name: prepared_only_current_value_new_is_applied
note: No later prepared entry: the current value under the lock decides.

name: prepared_only_current_value_old_is_refused
note: No later prepared entry: the ref still has the old value.

name: prepared_only_current_value_other_is_unknown
note: The ref holds a third value and no prepared entry explains it.

name: prepared_only_current_value_not_quiescent_waits
note: A value read while a receive was in progress is not a consistent boundary.

name: prepared_only_current_value_not_read_waits
note: The value must be read under the lock with no receive in progress.

name: journal_unreadable_is_unknown
note: Never decide from refs alone.

name: journal_without_own_entry_is_unknown
note: A committing entry always has its prepared entry first; its absence means a lost or older journal.

name: aba_successor_prepared_then_predecessor_committed_late
note: Ref A. R1 A->B prepared, R2 B->A prepared (it saw B), R1's committed entry is appended after R2's prepared entry, R2 crashed. R2 is refused, not applied.

name: aba_predecessor_is_applied_by_its_own_late_committed_entry
note: The same journal settles the predecessor applied.

name: aba_successor_that_really_committed_is_applied
note: The value read under the lock shows the successor's result.

name: aba_later_prepared_entry_decides_the_successor
note: R3 prepared after R2 and observed B, so R2 (B->A) did not commit; late outcome entries are ignored.

name: identical_tuples_crashed_receive_is_refused_not_confused_with_the_other
note: R1 and R2 both A->B; R1 crashed after prepared, R2 committed. The ref holds B, yet R1 is refused: R2's prepared entry observed A.

name: identical_tuples_committed_receive_is_applied
note: The receive that committed is applied by its own entry.

name: identical_tuples_first_committed_second_contradicted
note: R1 committed A->B but lost its outcome entry; R2 (A->B) then observed B, which contradicts its old value.

name: identical_tuples_first_committed_applied_by_next_prepared
note: The same journal settles R1 applied from R2's observed value.

name: restored_older_journal_is_unknown_never_refused
note: The control plane saw journal head 10; the volume now reports head 6 with only the prepared entry and the old value: a restore, so unknown.

name: restored_older_journal_without_the_entry_is_unknown
note: The restored journal lacks the entry entirely; the regression, not the missing entry, is the finding.

name: restored_older_journal_committed_entry_is_unknown
note: Even an own committed entry from a journal older than one already seen is not accepted (GR-A13).

name: restored_older_journal_aborted_entry_is_unknown_never_refused
note: An own aborted entry from an older journal never settles the entry refused.

name: restored_older_journal_next_prepared_is_unknown
note: A later prepared entry from an older journal does not decide either.

name: committed_with_observed_contradicting_old_is_unknown
note: An outcome entry does not rescue an entry whose observed value contradicts old.

name: aborted_with_observed_equal_to_new_is_unknown
note: The same guard for an aborted entry.

name: journal_head_equal_to_known_head_is_not_a_regression
note: The control plane's own last read.

name: own_committed_and_aborted_conflict
note: Contradictory evidence is never resolved by guessing.

name: own_entry_with_other_tuple_conflicts
note: The journal attributes a different update to this receive and ref.

name: two_own_prepared_entries_conflict
note: One ref transaction per receive and ref.

name: forced_update_with_zero_old_uses_the_observed_value
note: Old is all-zero for a forced update; the value observed under the lock is the before-value: the next prepared entry observing it means refused.

name: forced_update_with_zero_old_applied
note: The next prepared entry observed the new value.

name: observed_contradicting_old_is_unknown
note: Git verified old under the lock, so a different observed value contradicts the entry.

name: observed_equal_to_new_is_ambiguous
note: A transaction that changes nothing cannot be told from one that did not run.

name: duplicate_sequence_conflicts
note: A journal cannot append two entries at one position.

name: outcome_without_prepared_conflicts
note: The prepared entry is always written first.

name: outcome_before_prepared_conflicts
note: An outcome cannot precede its own prepared entry.

name: invalid_journal_entry_conflicts
note: A prepared entry without its observed value is malformed evidence.

name: entry_beyond_journal_head_conflicts
note: An entry past the reported head is inconsistent.

name: delete_applied_by_next_prepared_observing_absence
note: Deleting a ref: the next prepared entry observed the all-zero value.

name: delete_refused_by_current_value
note: Deleting a ref: it still has the old value.

name: outcome_of_another_receive_never_settles_this_one
note: Another receive committed the identical tuple later; this one only prepared, and the ref still has the old value.

name: outcome_entries_never_order_other_transactions
note: A late aborted entry of another receive between prepared entries is ignored; the next prepared entry decides.

name: entries_of_other_refs_are_ignored
note: The same receive's committed entry for another ref is not evidence for this ref.

name: next_prepared_is_the_lowest_sequence_after_the_entry
note: Journal order in the input does not matter; the smallest later sequence decides.

name: server_operation_prepared_entry_orders_like_a_receive
note: A server operation's prepared entry is the next transaction on the ref.

name: sha256_object_ids
note: Object IDs of 64 digits behave the same.

name: applied_entry_stays_applied
note: A final entry is returned unchanged.

name: refused_entry_stays_refused
note: A final entry is returned unchanged.

name: unknown_entry_waits_for_an_operator
note: Reconciliation never resolves an unknown entry by itself.
